UltraWeather.name: UltraWeather
UltraWeather.description_zh: 進階天氣 / 天空系統 — 體積雲、霧色、天空時程表、post-process 覆寫。Client-only（需要 local player controller + viewport，dedicated server 不適用）。

client._note: UE4SS Lua mod by Fr4nsson (Steam workshop 4504). client-only — uses IsLocalPlayerController + viewport world checks; refuses to run on dedicated server.

_comment: Friend-facing mod catalog. friend_allowed: true 為朋友可裝。
_how_to_use:
1. 上傳到 GitHub public repo
2. 朋友在 .exe 裡貼 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/USER/REPO/main/friend-catalog.json
3. 本地測試可用 file:///C:/path/to/friend-catalog.json
_security_note:
friend_common.py 會在 install 時自動驗每個 component 的 SHA256 跟這裡的 sha256 欄位。
Mismatch 會拒絕安裝（避免 MITM / 檔案損壞 / 惡意 fork）。
要新增 mod：在這裡加 sha256 跟 updated 欄位。
_changelog:
2026-08-02: add Ultra Weather 1.0.1 (Fr4nsson workshop 4504)
  - client-side only (uses IsLocalPlayerController + viewport world; dedicated server skips)
  - UE4SS Lua mod: volumetric clouds + sky creator schedule + height fog tint + post-process override
  - installed to Pal/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss/Mods/UltraWeather/
  - installer already supports one-click install/uninstall via existing component pipeline

2026-08-02: switch BREEDING HELPER distribution to CrazyChips' v1.1 custom build:
  - server side: CrazyChips' patched lua scripts (screen_msg no-op, BtnAuthor no-op, hidden TitleText)
  - client side: identical .pak bytes as stock (the .pak is stock UI assets; patches are lua-side)
  - installer: CrazyChips' install.bat is the reference implementation; friend tool now points at his v1.1 zip
